summary: Nyxoah SA filed a Form 6-K reporting receipt of $15 million (€13.8 million) from the second tranche of its existing European Investment Bank loan facility, a non-dilutive debt drawdown following satisfaction of predefined criteria. The filing also announces an extraordinary shareholders meeting on July 9, 2026, and includes a press release. This is a routine financing event under a pre-existing facility, not a special situation. No special-situation category applies.
